notes: Reusable structural-transfer evidence only; no benchmark-specific tuning and no library acceptance. The unit-aware paving tranche materially advanced the shared subsystem: local-metre sampling, construction-safe binding, coverage and visibility invariants now transfer across both hosts. Visual acceptance remains rejected and the remaining paving failure is localized to granular joint/substrate response, per-unit and macro weathering, oversized contemporary construction, and receiver-aware water. Further scene-local tuning is not justified.
